item.tib: pad ma thugs kyi rtsa rgyud rig 'dzin bsgrubs pa'i cha lag las khyung sgrub gser tso 'khyil pa'i so sor mngon rtogs
item.coloph: de ltar gser dz+wa 'khyil ba'i mngon rtogs 'di/ dad ldan mched grogs rnams kyis (mchan dbon po ye shes snying pos gtsor byas)bskul ba'i ngor/ khyung sgrub gzhan dang mi 'gal (mchan bde chen mi 'gyur snying pos) phyir du bkod/ nyes 'gal ci mchis dpal ldan bla ma dang / rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyongs srung ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog gsal byed 'di yang kun la 'phel gyur cig/

item.tib: pad ma thugs kyi rtsa rgyud rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i cha lag khyung sgrub gser tso 'khyil ba'i mngon rtogs
